text: Implemented chunk-safe fit execution across commits 889be25 and 57c0c08. Evidence: typed PreparedFitContext and GlsPrepared prevent per-chunk GLS re-estimation; FitChunkProgram plus sequential and bounded Future interpreters define the scheduler-neutral boundary; FitPlanExecutor.fitChunked and fitChunkedFuture remain the public ergonomic entry points. Verified with focused ChunkedFitExecutorSuite on JVM/JS and full fitJVM/test fitJS/test.
